title: Assisted reset with eccentric heel lowering
subdomain: Unilateral affected-side lowering with sound-limb reset; do not substitute a bilateral heel raise.
concept: Assisted reset with eccentric heel lowering
summary: Using a stable hand support and a low platform, the sound leg performs the step-up/reset. Weight transfers to the ball of the affected foot, then the affected heel lowers slowly through a lengthening gastrocnemius-soleus contraction. Resetting with the sound limb avoids concentric loading of the affected ankle in this described sequence.
